finding_summary: Recovery must be scored jointly with recovery cost; success alone cannot distinguish local repair from full restart.
Reuse earns credit only when retained plan/dependency material remains valid after the change.
Benchmark against from-scratch replanning and, where deterministically available, a post-change oracle/shortest valid plan.
Transfer should cross explicit structural/family boundaries rather than merely random seeds.
Evaluator owns perturbation/ground truth; SUT receives only admitted public change/observation.
For small micro-worlds, full replanning may legitimately outperform incremental repair; preserve that negative result if measured.
external_basis: Repair the Amplifier, Not the Symptom arXiv:2607.01767
A Close Look At World Model Recovery arXiv:2606.03685
reason: WP804 goal-inference research/build evidence is actively moving in parallel; mapping WP805 recovery against an unstable goal interface would create avoidable staleness.
